Job Summary

Position: AI Engineer - TG02
Engagement Mode: Remote
5-6 Year
Position Overview: We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer with strong expertise in production-ready Python and AI service development. The role focuses on LLM application engineering, generative image workflows, and implementing robust evaluation and quality assurance processes for AI-generated content.


Responsibilities

Develop production-ready Python and AI services
Build and maintain LLM applications
Implement generative image workflows including text-to-image and image editing
Design and implement RAG systems with context selection and source-of-truth binding
Mitigate hallucination in AI-generated outputs
Establish evaluation and QA processes for text and image outputs
Create test sets, rubrics, and regression testing frameworks
Implement human review loops for quality assurance


Required Skills

5+ years of proven experience in production ready Python + AI service development
Hands-on experience with LLM application engineering
Generative image workflow experience (text-to-image + image editing)
RAG grounding (context selection, source-of-truth binding, hallucination mitigation)
Evaluation QA for both text + images (test sets, rubrics, regression, human review loops)


Preferred (Bonus) Skills

Document generation/templating
Cost/performance optimisation monitoring


Job Details

Job Category: AI Engineer
Job Type: Contract (6-12 Months)
Job Location: Remote
